rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for a tablet computer.

example.english: I watch movies on my tablet.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 ping4 baan2 din6 nou5 tai2 hei3

rows.note: Use this for a flat or compressed medicinal tablet rather than a computer.

example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 joek6 pin3 jiu3 faan6 hau6 sik6

rows.note: Use this when the pill is understood as a rounded medicine pill rather than a flat tablet.

example.english: This tablet should be swallowed whole.
example.traditional: 呢粒藥丸要成粒吞落肚。
example.jyutping: ni1 lap1 joek6 jyun2 jiu3 seng4 lap1 tan1 lok6 tou5
